name: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort, Costa Rica

transfer_minutes.label: Approximately 35–50 minutes from Guanacaste Airport (LIR), depending on traffic.

hero_image_alt: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort surrounded by tropical forest in Guanacaste
description: Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort is a design-forward luxury property set within the private Peninsula Papagayo. Its beaches, golf access, dining and activity program make it a good match for travelers who want an upscale resort experience with a relaxed Costa Rican identity and convenient access to private day tours.
hero_description: A design-forward luxury resort with a relaxed Costa Rican spirit inside Peninsula Papagayo.
local_insight: Andaz is a strong match for travelers who want upscale comfort without an overly formal atmosphere. Its Papagayo location makes it easy to combine beach time, dining and private day trips across Guanacaste.

faq.q: Which airport should I use for Andaz Costa Rica?
faq.a: Guanacaste Airport (LIR) is the closest practical international airport. Private transportation can be arranged directly to the resort.

faq.q: Can I visit waterfalls and wildlife areas from Andaz?
faq.a: Yes. Full-day private tours can connect the resort with wildlife, rainforest, waterfall and volcano experiences across Guanacaste.

faq.q: Do I need a rental car at Andaz Papagayo?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Travelers who plan to stay at the resort and use organized private tours can often manage the trip with airport transfers and excursion transportation.

source_notes: The official Hyatt page describes a luxury eco resort within the private 1,400-acre Peninsula Papagayo, with three beaches, golf, dining and an extensive activity program.
Transfer time is presented as an operational estimate and can vary with traffic and the exact airport pickup time.
